notes: Scan > Compare: see what changed between two scans (only change beyond what the scans can detect is coloured) and check a scan against a design surface, each with a PDF report. DTM: choose each cell's height (mean, median, lowest, 10th percentile) and see thin or noisy cells before signing it. Change detection is about 4x faster on large scans.
